# Kshana

> Open-source GNSS jamming and spoofing simulator for PNT (positioning, navigation and timing) resilience: holdover, RAIM, lunar navigation, in your browser. Version 0.40.0, AGPL-3.0-only licence, by Ashforde® OÜ. 176 of 401 capabilities are validated against external oracles; the rest are labelled Modelled or partner-owned.

Kshana is a deterministic Rust engine for PNT (positioning, navigation and timing) resilience studies: GNSS (global navigation satellite system) jamming and spoofing, clock holdover, RAIM (receiver autonomous integrity monitoring) and protection levels, orbits, low-Earth-orbit navigation, and navigation at the Moon and Mars. Every scenario is a TOML file; every run is reproducible from its scenario, seed and engine version. It drives no radio hardware and transmits nothing: its signal-level output is baseband IQ sample files for software receivers, its software GNSS receiver is an analysis tool, and it is not a flight product.

## Site

- [Kshana: open-source GNSS jamming and spoofing simulator](https://kshana.dev/): Open-source GNSS jamming and spoofing simulator for PNT (positioning, navigation and timing) resilience: holdover, RAIM, lunar navigation, in your browser.
- [Missions: GNSS and PNT resilience by sector](https://kshana.dev/missions): GNSS jamming, spoofing and clock holdover scenarios for ten sectors, from defence, aviation and maritime to telecom timing and lunar navigation.
- [Capabilities: GNSS, clocks, orbits, Moon and Mars](https://kshana.dev/capabilities): GNSS signal bands and jamming, clock holdover, timing masks, integrity monitoring (RAIM), orbits and lunar navigation: every scenario kind on one map.
- [Evidence: validation against external oracles](https://kshana.dev/evidence): Which Kshana capabilities are validated against independent oracles and which are modelled: verification matrix, validation ledger, papers and citation.
- [Install Kshana: CLI, Rust, Python, npm and MCP server](https://kshana.dev/developers): Install Kshana as a command-line tool, Rust crate, Python or npm package, Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, container or JetBrains plugin.
- [Benchmark: GNSS interference detection](https://kshana.dev/benchmark): kshana-bench: fixed tasks, splits and metrics for GNSS interference detection and timing holdover, pre-registered baselines and a board of result files.
- [Editions: open source and Kshana Pro](https://kshana.dev/editions): Kshana is free and open source under the AGPL-3.0 licence. Kshana Pro adds a design optimiser, uncertainty and sensitivity studies and a mission dossier.
- [Kshana Studio](https://kshana.dev/studio/): Run GNSS jamming, spoofing, holdover and integrity scenarios in your browser. The open-source engine runs locally as WebAssembly; nothing is uploaded.

## Install

- Command line (Rust): `cargo install kshana` (https://crates.io/crates/kshana)
- Rust library: `cargo add kshana` (https://crates.io/crates/kshana)
- Python: `pip install kshana` (https://pypi.org/project/kshana/)
- JavaScript and WebAssembly: `npm install kshana` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/kshana)
- AI assistant (MCP server, cargo): `cargo install kshana-mcp` (https://crates.io/crates/kshana-mcp)
- Docker image: `docker run --rm -i ghcr.io/ashfordeou/kshana-mcp` (https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/pkgs/container/kshana-mcp)
- Cursor (one click): `npx -y kshana-mcp@0.40.0`
- VS Code (one click): `npx -y kshana-mcp@0.40.0`
- npx: `npx -y kshana-mcp@0.40.0` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/kshana-mcp)
- uvx / pipx: `uvx kshana-mcp==0.40.0` (https://pypi.org/project/kshana-mcp/)
- Homebrew: `brew install ashfordeOU/tap/kshana-mcp` (https://github.com/ashfordeOU/homebrew-tap)
- Scoop: `scoop bucket add ashforde https://github.com/ashfordeOU/scoop-bucket && scoop install kshana-mcp` (https://github.com/ashfordeOU/scoop-bucket)
- winget: `winget install AshfordeOU.KshanaMcp` (https://github.com/microsoft/winget-pkgs)
- Remote (streamable HTTP), self-hosted: `kshana-mcp --http 127.0.0.1:8080`
- Signal K plugin: `npm install signalk-kshana-trust` (https://www.npmjs.com/package/signalk-kshana-trust)
- Reference-build image: `docker pull ghcr.io/ashfordeou/kshana-reference-build` (https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana/pkgs/container/kshana-reference-build)
- Source code: https://github.com/ashfordeOU/kshana
- Cite the software: DOI [10.5281/zenodo.20528627](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20528627)

## Research

- [Cislunar navigation is an observability problem: arc-length thresholds, Gramian conditioning, and the Doppler lever](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23871): arXiv 2610.23871. In cislunar space dilution of precision does not apply: range-only links leave the velocity unobservable at any instant, so requirements belong in arc-length, conditioning and measurement-type budgets.
- [The Cost of Lunar South-Polar Geometry, and Surface Beacons as the Efficient Fix: A Dilution-of-Precision Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.06212): arXiv 2607.06212. Planned orbits bunch overhead for a lunar south-pole user; a few ranging beacons on nearby high ground fix the geometry more cheaply than more satellites.
- [Earth-baseline VLBI restores the observability of a lunar surface station in joint orbit-and-clock determination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.02566): arXiv 2607.02566. Lunar-network ranging fixes only relative geometry; an Earth-baseline very-long-baseline interferometry delay ties a surface station to the Earth frame, even with few satellites.
- [A Conditional Timing Protection Level: Holdover-Limited Undetected Time Error Under GNSS Spoofing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24210): arXiv 2606.24210. A recorded spoof shows a timing receiver serving time far more wrong than it reports; no unconditional bound exists, so the paper bounds the undetected error conditionally.
- [How Stable Is a PNT Resilience Score? Decision-Instability of Single-Number Resilience Ratings under Framework-Aligned Weighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05415): arXiv 2607.05415. Single-number resilience ratings for positioning, navigation and timing are stable only where one design dominates; weighting, threat and declared techniques can flip them.
- [Anticipating the Optimism Gap: Predicting Distribution-Shift Degradation of RF-Impairment Detectors from In-Distribution Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.22054): arXiv 2606.22054. How much an interference detector loses under shifted conditions can be predicted from its own in-distribution scores; synthetic results, checked on open field recordings.

- [Kshana for JetBrains IDEs](https://kshana.dev/docs/jetbrains): Install: Kshana — PNT simulator on the JetBrains Marketplace — or, in any JetBrains IDE, Settings → Plugins → Marketplace → search "Kshana".

- [Where Kshana sits](https://kshana.dev/docs/positioning): Kshana is an open, reproducible PNT (positioning, navigation and timing) resilience evidence engine.
